title: Northern Irish Breakfast Skillet
description: A hearty breakfast skillet filled with the flavors of Northern Ireland and a hint of Mexican twist, perfect for a weekend morning.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium heat.
Add the butter and let it melt.
Once melted, add the Northern Irish flour and whisk it into a smooth paste.
Gradually pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until it thickens.
Meanwhile, cook the Northern Irish full breakfast sausage in a separate pan over medium heat.
Once cooked, slice the sausage into rounds and set aside.
Add the sliced aubergine to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until it's tender.
Scramble the English eggs in a separate bowl and set aside.
To assemble the skillet, add the cooked aubergine, scrambled eggs, and sliced sausage to the skillet.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
